title: Reversibility Scoring: A Lightweight Metric for Real-Time Action Risk Classification

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Clear chain: reversibility classification enables proportionate safety interventions. Anthropic's guidance recommends human approval for irreversible actions but no tool exists. Filling this gap directly improves agent safety practice.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Training a small text classifier on synthetic action logs is a standard ML task. Generating synthetic data, labeling reversibility, and computing inter-rater reliability are well-documented techniques. Fully accessible to CS students with beginner ML experience.
